info.name: PioneerX AI API v1.5
info.description:
PioneerX AI API Collection — Backend v1.5.

Changes from v1.4:
- Credit system (GET /credit-status, credits reserved/confirmed per AI call)
- Image generation (POST /image/generate — logo / business card, DALL-E 3)
- Notifications (list unread, mark read, mark all read)
- Promo codes (POST /auth/apply-promo, optional promoCode at register/magic-link)
- Reviews (public GET /reviews, authenticated POST /reviews, admin moderation)
- Send Message now auto-generates action steps + links (returns generationId, action_steps, suggested_links, creditStatus)
- GET /saved-outputs supports optional ?sectionKey= filter
- GET /sections now returns ALL sections with isLocked flag
- Admin: credit configs, broadcast notifications, promo code CRUD, review moderation
- Quota config now includes dailyImageLimit

request.description:
Sends a magic link login email. If user does not exist, creates account with 3-day trial. Always returns { message: 'Check your email' }.

v1.5: Body also accepts optional "promoCode" (string). If provided and the account is new, the promo trial is applied at signup.

query.description: The token received in the magic link email

request.description: Verifies magic link token and issues JWT access + refresh tokens. Token expires in 15 minutes and is single-use.
Redirects the user to Google OAuth consent screen. Open this in a browser, not Postman.

NEW in v1.5. Applies a promo code to the current (authenticated) user and extends/starts their trial by the code's trialDays.

Errors: 404 invalid code, 400 expired / max uses reached / already redeemed by this user.
Returns { activeProfile, profiles[] } for the current user.

Create a new business profile.

v1.4: Free tier allows max 3 profiles (403 if exceeded). PRO / PRO_PLUS / ELITE = unlimited.
Sets this profile as active. Conversations / generate / daily tasks use the active profile.
Cannot delete your only remaining profile.
v1.5: Returns ALL active sections (no tier filtering). Each item includes isLocked (boolean) so the UI can show locked sections with an upgrade prompt.

request.description:
Finds conversation for { userId, activeProfileId, section }. Creates one if missing.
Returns conversation + all messages ordered by createdAt ASC.

Manual re-generate. Uses last 10 conversation messages.
No body required.

v1.5: Consumes credits (402 if insufficient). Response also includes creditStatus.

Returns: { generationId, action_steps[4], suggested_links[4], tokenStatus, creditStatus }

Auto-saves generation_id to collection variable for Save Output.

item.description: Section-scoped chatbot. v1.5: every message auto-generates action steps + suggested links and consumes credits.

item.name: Reviews

request.description: NEW in v1.5. PUBLIC endpoint (no auth). Returns approved reviews only, used by the landing page testimonials section.

NEW in v1.5. Authenticated user submits a review.

Body: { roleCompany?: string, reviewText: string, rating?: 1-5 }

One review per user — the reviewer name is taken from the user's account (not from the body). Submitting again UPDATES the existing review.

Reviews are AUTO-APPROVED and appear in GET /reviews immediately. Admin can hide one later via PATCH /admin/reviews/:id/reject.

item.description: NEW in v1.5 — real review system. Reviews go live immediately (auto-approved); admin can hide any review via reject.
